answer_1.quote: In this paper, we first conduct a preliminary study to investigate the impact of the domain gap on the datastore retrieval of kNN-MT. Furthermore, we propose a reviser to refine the key representations of the original kNN-MT datastore in an offline manner, making them more suitable for the downstream domain.

answer_2.quote: Finally, we use two metrics: case-sensitive detokenized BLEU and COMET, to evaluate the quality of translation.
